description: Fix cross-platform line ending issues in a Git repository. The repository at /home/ga/workspace/payment-service has all files with CRLF (Windows) line endings, causing Git to show false modifications on Linux. Your tasks: (1) Configure VSCode workspace settings to use LF line endings by creating/modifying .vscode/settings.json with 'files.eol' set to 'lf', (2) Convert all text files from CRLF to LF endings - this includes .py, .js, .sh, .md, and .json files (do NOT modify the binary file logo.png), (3) Create a .gitattributes file at repository root with rules to enforce LF line endings (e.g., '* text=auto eol=lf'), (4) Verify that scripts/deploy.sh now has LF endings so it can execute on Linux, (5) Ensure Git no longer shows false modifications (git status should show only the new .vscode/settings.json and .gitattributes files as changes). The shell script scripts/deploy.sh is particularly critical as it currently fails with 'bad interpreter' error due to CRLF endings.
